title: Entrepreneurialism and Self-Employment
text: Researching entrepreneurialism and self-employment. You will explore how independent careers begin, develop, and succeed.

title: Introduction
bullets: Entrepreneurs and self-employed people create their own opportunities by spotting needs and solving problems
This lesson explores real examples, the skills required, and how independent careers develop
You will research, reflect, and consider whether this type of career suits you
Lesson outline: explore concepts, research a role, identify skills and challenges, present findings, reflect on personal fit

title: Success Criteria
bullets: I can explain what entrepreneurialism and self-employment mean
I can research a real example of an entrepreneur or self-employed role
I can identify challenges and skills linked to independent careers

title: Key Words
bullets: Business Model – How a business makes money
Entrepreneurial Strategy – A plan for starting, running, and growing a business
Resilience – The ability to keep going after setbacks or difficulties
Career Independence – Taking control of your own career path and decisions

title: Starter Activity
bullets: What appeals to you about working for yourself?
Why do you think resilience is important in independent careers?

title: Entrepreneurialism and Self-Employment in Action
bullets: Entrepreneurialism involves identifying opportunities, developing solutions, taking risks, and adapting from mistakes
Self-employment means working independently and may involve trades, freelancing, online selling, or running a business
Many independent careers start small and evolve over time, influenced by technology, society, and customer needs
Success requires responsibility, planning, and flexibility

title: Activity – Exploring Independent Careers
text: Choose a self-employed role to research. Record key information on: what the role involves, skills needed, challenges and benefits. Reflect on whether this type of work could suit you and why or why not.

title: Independent Careers
sentence: Independent careers require ______, planning, and flexibility.

title: Key Takeaways
bullets: Entrepreneurial and self-employed careers require initiative, resilience, and adaptability
Researching and understanding independent roles helps you make informed choices about your career path
